calls.title: Box + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed transitioning to GrowthBook as an open-source experimentation and feature flagging platform to improve Box's experimentation processes and support product-led growth. GrowthBook's features include SQL-based integrations, retroactive metric analysis, advanced statistical analysis, and customizable workflows, promising reduced operational complexity compared to current tools like Adobe Target. Participants raised concerns about existing tool ecosystems and the need for automation in experiment management. They emphasized the importance of optimizing user journeys and increasing marketing qualified leads (MQLs) while exploring less intrusive data capture methods. Moving forward, Box will evaluate GrowthBook alongside other platforms to ensure comprehensive support for their multi-stack testing needs.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flagging, Adobe Target, Personalization, Data Integration, Programmatic Automation
